parameters.name: BSSID
parameters.description: The BSSID indicated by the neighboring BSS.

parameters.name: SSID
parameters.description: The SSID indicated by the neighboring BSS.

parameters.name: SignalStrength
parameters.description: An indicator of radio signal strength (RSSI) of the Beacon or Probe Response frames of the neighboring BSS as received by the radio measured in {{units}}. (RSSI is encoded per {{bibref|802.11-2020|Table 9-176}}). Reserved: 221 - 255.

parameters.name: ChannelBandwidth
parameters.description: Indicates the maximum bandwidth at which the neighboring BSS is operating. e.g. "1" or "2" or "4" or "8"” or "16" or "20" or "40" or "80" or "80+80" or "160" or "320" MHz.

parameters.name: ChannelUtilization
parameters.description: The channel utilization reported by the neighboring BSS per the BSS Load element if present in Beacon or Probe Response frames, as defined by {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 9.4.2.27}}.

parameters.name: StationCount
parameters.description: The number of Associated Devices (STA) reported by this neighboring BSS per the BSS Load element if present in Beacon or Probe Response frames as defined by {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 9.4.2.27}}.

parameters.name: MLDMACAddress
parameters.description: The Multi-Link Device (MLD) MAC address of the Multi-Link Operation (MLO) capable access point this neighboring BSS is affiliated to. Null if the neighboring BSS is not an affiliated AP.

parameters.name: ReportingBSSID
parameters.description: The BSSID of the reporting BSSID if different from {{param|BSSID}}. This will be set if the NeigborBSS was discovered through, for example, a Reduced Neighbor Report. EasyMesh {{bibref|EasyMesh}} source: Channel Scan Result TLV.

parameters.name: MultiBSSID
parameters.description: Indicates if the neighboring BSS is part of a MultiBSSID set and may be a non-transmitted BSSID.

parameters.name: BSSLoadElementPresent
parameters.description: Set to true if the neighbour BSS Beacon/Probe Responses include a BSSLoad Element as defined in {{bibref|802.11-2020|Section 9.4.2.28}}.

parameters.name: BSSColor
parameters.description: Set to the BSS Color from the BSS Color Information field in the BSS's HE Operation element.

object.description: The neighboring BSS discovered by a Radio during a channel scan. For MLDs, {{param|MLDMACAddress}} identifies the APMLD for which this NeighborBSS.{i}. is an affilated AP, other affiliated APs in this {{object}} have the same value of {{param|MLDMACAddress}}.
